from AlgorithmImports import *


class AppleSplitStrategy(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2014, 1, 2)
        self.SetEndDate(2020, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(100000)

        equity = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily)
        equity.SetDataNormalizationMode(DataNormalizationMode.Raw)
        self.aapl = equity.Symbol

        self.split_day = None
        self.trading_days_since_split = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        if data is None or not data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl):
            return

        split_occurred = False
        if data.Splits.ContainsKey(self.aapl):
            split = data.Splits[self.aapl]
            if split is not None and split.Type == SplitType.SplitOccurred:
                self.SetHoldings(self.aapl, 1)
                self.split_day = self.Time.date()

class AppleSplitBuyer(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2014, 1, 2)
        self.SetEndDate(2020, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(100000)

        equity = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily)
        equity.SetDataNormalizationMode(DataNormalizationMode.Raw)
        self.aapl = equity.Symbol

        self.split_date = None
        self.trading_days_since_split = None
        self.last_counted_date = None

    def OnData(self, data):
        if data is None:
            return

        split = None
        if data.Splits is not None and self.aapl in data.Splits:
            split = data.Splits[self.aapl]

        if split is not None and split.Type == SplitType.SplitOccurred:
            self.split_date = self.Time.date()
            self.trading_days_since_split = 0
            self.last_counted_date = self.split_date
            self.SetHoldings(self.aapl, 1.0)
            return

        if self.trading_days_since_split is None:
            return

        current_date = self.Time.date()
        if current_date == self.last_counted_date:
            return

        security = self.Securities[self.aapl]
        if not security.Exchange.DateIsOpen(self.Time):
            return

        self.last_counted_date = current_date
        self.trading_days_since_split += 1

        if self.trading_days_since_split == 10:
            self.Liquidate(self.aapl)
            self.split_date = None
            self.trading_days_since_split = None
            self.last_counted_date = None
